senses.gloss:
MAID, MAIDEN:
I A girl: q. v.: कन्या।
II
A virgin: q. v.: कन्या।
III A maid-ser-
-vant: चेटी।

MAIDEN (adj.): Lit.: expr. by comp.
II
New, pure: q. v.: अभिनवः (वा, वं).

MAIDENLY: कन्यकोचितः (ता, तं) and sim.
comp.s: v. Becoming.
MAIDENHAIR: a plant: *सुकेशी।

MAIN (subs.):
I Strength: q. v.
II The
ocean: महासमुद्रः।
III Mainland: q. v.
IV A pipe. Ph.: for the m., in the m.: v.
Mainly.

Main (adj.): मुख्य (f. ख्या): v. Chief, prin-
-cipal.
Mainland: महादेशः: v. Continent.

MAINLY:
(1) प्रधानतः;
(2) प्राधान्येनः v. Prin-
-cipally.

MAINPRIZE: प्रातिभाव्येन मुक्तिः।
Writ of m.:
प्राति-
भाव्येन मोचननिदेशः (?).
MAINSAIL: मुख्यवातवसनम् (?) and sim. comp.s.
MAINSPRING: Fig.: निदानम्: v. Chief, cause.

MAINTAIN:
I To hold: q. v.: धरति (धृ, c.
1.).
II To keep, defend: रक्षति (रक्ष्, c
l.).
III To continue: q. v.
IV To
support: भरति
or
बिमर्ति, सं-, (भृ, c. 1. and
3.), daughters should be m. ed till marriage:
दुहितरः परिणयनं यावद्भर्तव्याः, Da.
IV To affirm
and defend:
(1) भरति
or
बिभर्ति (?);
(2)
ब्रवीति (ब्रू, c. 2 (= to assert: q. v.).

MAINTAINER: भर्तृ (f. र्त्री) (= supporter) or
by verb.

MAINTENANCE:
I Holding: धारणम्, -सं।
II
Defence: रक्षा।
III Support:
(1) भरणम्;
(2) भृतिः।
III Means of support:
(1) वृत्तिः;
(2) ग्रासाच्छादनम् (= food and clothing: as
for wives), Da.

MAIZE: मधूली (?), Bha.; भुट्टा and जुनार in
modern dialects.
